data.content_ref: inline:Develop a persistent incremental algorithm that, after each variator edit, updates the skeptical fixpoint by recomputing only the affected subgraph, with a worst-case amortized polynomial bound and a formal proof of correctness. This builds on the caching idea but provides a rigorous complexity analysis and handles deletions and insertions uniformly. Criticism: the dependency tracking may introduce overhead and bugs; memory usage could be high for large graphs.
